resources.string:
Shlinker requires HTTPS and currently accepts only publicly trusted certificates, such as those from Let's Encrypt.

Self-signed certificates and private certificate authorities are not supported yet.

Installing a private CA in Android settings is not sufficient.
Your Shlink address, e.g. s.example.org or example.org/shlink. HTTPS is added automatically.

Create an API key on your Shlink server:
shlink api-key:generate

With Docker:
docker exec -it <container> shlink api-key:generate

Your API key is stored encrypted on this device, protected by Android Keystore, and excluded from backups.
HTTP is not supported. Use HTTPS to protect your API key.
The server address must not contain query parameters or a fragment.
The saved API key cannot be decrypted. Please enter it again.
